significance: One of the five sacred lakes of Hinduism, the Panch-Sarovar, in Lakhpat taluka of Kutch. Its main temples were built in 1734 by Vagheli Mahakunvar, wife of Rao Deshalji I, with the Kalyanray temple added in 1828.
story: The Saraswati river is said to have reached the sea near this spot, which is what made the lake holy.
